bullets.text: Risky Free VPN Surge - Users are flocking to free VPNs amid the Online Safety Act, risking their privacy instead of securing it.
5G Mobile Core Growth - The 5G mobile core network surged 31% in Q2 2025, driven by subscriber growth and new launches.
BT Expands Cloud Partnership - BT Group's new five-year deal with **AWS** aims to modernise its technology for better customer experiences.
Open RAN 5G at Stadium - **Boldyn Networks** and **VMO2** enhance 5G connectivity at Sunderland’s Stadium of Light using Open RAN technology.
Global DDoS Attacks Rise - Over 8 million DDoS attacks were recorded in H1 2025, often timed with major political events.
Nokia's Rail Connectivity - **Nokia** introduces a new 5G radio solution to modernise rail communications and support digital transformation.
AI-RAN Trials by KT - **KT** tests AI-driven radio access technology on its 5G network, aiming for enhanced performance and future 6G readiness.
Private 5G for Offshore - **Tampnet** deploys private 5G networks for offshore drilling and production units in the North Sea.
